verses.t: Recite in the name of your Lord who created
verses.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth
verses.yusufAli: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created
verses.rodwell: RECITE thou, in the name of thy Lord who created
verses.sale: Read, in the name of thy Lord, Who hath created all things

verses.t: Created man from a clinging substance
verses.yusufAli: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood
verses.rodwell: Created man from CLOTS OF BLOOD
verses.sale: who hath created man of congealed blood

verses.t: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous
verses.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous
verses.yusufAli: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful
verses.rodwell: Recite thou! For thy Lord is the most Beneficent
verses.sale: Read, by thy most beneficent Lord

verses.yusufAli: He Who taught (the use of) the pen
verses.rodwell: Who hath taught the use of the pen
verses.sale: Who taught the use of the pen

verses.t: Taught man that which he knew not
verses.pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not
verses.yusufAli: Taught man that which he knew not
verses.rodwell: Hath taught Man that which he knoweth not
verses.sale: Who teacheth man that which he knoweth not

verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
verses.yusufAli: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds
In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient
verses.rodwell: Because he seeth himself possessed of riches
verses.sale: because he seeth himself abound in riches

verses.t: Indeed, to your Lord is the return
verses.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return
verses.yusufAli: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all)
verses.rodwell: Verily, to thy Lord is the return of all
verses.sale: Verily unto thy Lord shall be the return of all

verses.t: Have you seen the one who forbids
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
verses.rodwell: What thinkest thou of him that holdeth back
verses.sale: What thinkest thou as to him

verses.yusufAli: A votary when he (turns) to pray
verses.rodwell: A servant of God when he prayeth
verses.sale: who forbiddeth our servant, when he prayeth

verses.t: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
verses.yusufAli: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance
verses.rodwell: What thinkest thou? Hath he followed the true Guidance
verses.sale: What thinkest thou; if he follow the right direction

verses.t: Have you seen if he denies and turns away
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward
verses.yusufAli: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away
verses.rodwell: What thinkest thou? Hath he treated the truth as a lie and turned his back
verses.sale: What thinkest thou; if he accuse the divine revelations of falsehood, and turn his back

verses.t: Does he not know that Allah sees
verses.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth
verses.yusufAli: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see
verses.rodwell: What! doth he not know how that God seeth
verses.sale: Doth he not know that God seeth

verses.t: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
verses.pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock
verses.yusufAli: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock
verses.rodwell: Nay, verily, if he desist not, We shall seize him by the forelock
verses.sale: Assuredly. Verily, if he forbear not, We will drag him by the forelock

verses.t: Then let him call his associates
verses.pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen
verses.yusufAli: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades)
verses.rodwell: Then let him summon his associates
verses.sale: And let him call his council to his assistance

verses.t: We will call the angels of Hell
verses.pickthall: We will call the guards of hell
verses.yusufAli: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)
verses.rodwell: We too will summon the guards of Hell
verses.sale: We also will call the infernal guards to cast him into hell

verses.t: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah)
verses.yusufAli: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)
verses.rodwell: Nay! obey him not; but adore, and draw nigh to God
verses.sale: Assuredly. Obey him not: But continue to adore God; and draw nigh unto Him
